tasks.name: Release
tasks.prompt: Release a new Agent Desktop version. Steps, in order: (1) Run the quality gate (yarn check:gate) and stop if anything fails. (2) Decide the version: find the latest v* tag (git describe --tags --abbrev=0); if package.json's version is already above it, release that version, otherwise bump the patch version (third number) unless told otherwise. (3) Write release notes for everything since the last tag (git log <last-tag>..HEAD, plus uncommitted changes) as a new `## <version> — <YYYY-MM-DD>` section at the top of CHANGELOG.md, above the previous version. Use short sections (### New / ### Improved / ### Fixed / ### Removed as needed) with bullets; each notable change gets bold text for its title followed by a short, impactful description and use case, e.g. `- **Jira Cloud sync**: link a plan to a Jira project so features push to issues and status flows back.` Skip internal-only chores, refactors, and CI work. (4) Bump the version in package.json only (CI syncs tauri.conf.json, Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock). (5) Commit as `chore(release): prepare v<version>` and push. If not on main, open a PR to main. Do NOT create the tag: the release workflow tags v<version> when the bump lands on main, builds the installers, and publishes the GitHub release using the CHANGELOG.md section as its body; the app shows the same notes in its What's new dialog after updating.

tasks.name: Openspec Status
